about: Real frames of amendments M64-M66 (D421-D423), cut from the bridge frame logs (var/games/<id>/frames.jsonl) of tools/ws-select-probe.mjs against the real engine, 2026-10-10, Forge 2.0.14. Read by web/test/selection.test.ts and tools/llm-seat/test/selection.test.mjs. docs/evidence/select-probe.md is the run.

source.command: ./bridge/run.sh mtgtable.MtgTable --transport ws --seed 11 --deck decks/select-probe.dck --ai-deck decks/doom-legion.dck --games 3; node tools/ws-select-probe.mjs --games 3
